title: Beautiful People I've Met Along the Way
subtitle: The friends, colleagues and kindred spirits this PhD gave me. The real result of five years.
intro: Photos and a few words for the people who made it. Kelly: just drop pictures into public/images/people/ — they appear here automatically. To add a name or caption, fill in the matching filename under 'captions' below (both are optional).
_comment: Photos auto-appear from public/images/people/, sorted by filename. Names/captions are OPTIONAL. To move a photo, give it a different sort-key under 'order' (the value is the filename whose position it should take). New photos don't need any entry here.
